_comment: Which SHAPE each structure family trades. One champion per family; the others are superseded, not disabled — they stay in engine.structures.STRUCTURES so old experiments replay and so a promotion can be rolled back. See engine/structure_registry.py.

champions.evidence: EXP-126 grid cell five_wide; promote.decide all-green 2026-09-04
champions.notes: CAGR 12.98% vs 6.14%, Sharpe 1.10 vs 0.85, positive in 9/9 OOS years vs 6/9, 393 trades on 217 tickers vs 90 on 79. Loses on max drawdown (14.3% vs 9.8%) and on breakeven alpha (0.467 vs 0.444) — it needs better fills than the shape it replaced.
